concepts.name: Тихая станция
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished portrait mobile game home screen concept, 9:16, for the existing Russian steampunk mine RPG Escape. The attached screenshot is ONLY a reference for the game's teal/amber painted industrial art and the bottom navigation/mine CTA, not an edit target. Concept A: «Тихая станция». Minimalist, calm, premium, immediately understandable navigation. A harmonious dim teal underground station with soft warm lamps and a clear physical floor; one medium-sized hooded mechanical explorer naturally grounded in the scene, matched lighting, no tiny floating character. Quiet background and generous negative space. Keep the bottom mine call-to-action card and five-item bottom navigation in recognizably the same structure as the reference, but simplify frame ornament to thin dark steel/brass edges. Upper screen: compact player avatar, nickname «ProKrust», «Уровень 24» and thin XP progress; small consistent inventory and settings controls; a single clean resources strip. Three clearly visible equal shortcut buttons with equally weighted icon AND text «Рейтинг», «Друзья», «Почта», all use the same dark high-contrast backing and consistent frames. Same coherent icon/button system for «Награда за вход», «Задания дня», «Магазин», «Мировой босс»; use compact paired rows, not scattered giant buttons. One amber primary action «В ШАХТУ» in the mine card above bottom navigation. Bottom labels exactly «Убежище», «Достижения», «Герой», «Арена», «Мастерская». Text sharp Russian Cyrillic, comfortably readable on a phone, values can be illustrative but plausible. Main feeling: a quiet real station scene with a disciplined interface laid over it. Avoid crowded ornament, excessive rivets, glowing borders on every button, tiny text, clashing button styles, watermarks, device frames, comparison layouts. One complete concept only, no title outside the interface.
concepts.refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit, ui-mockup. Refine ONLY the top profile/resources controls of this already-generated concept A mobile screen. Keep the station painting, character, consistent shortcut buttons, mine CTA and all bottom navigation exactly as designed. The current top incorrectly has only two resources and omits inventory. Replace the top header with a compact, clean full-width profile header containing the hooded avatar, ProKrust, Уровень 24, slim XP bar and equally sized inventory BAG and settings GEAR buttons at the right. Immediately beneath add one separate narrow tidy full-width resource strip with FOUR small resource icons and balances: ore, gold, purple matter, lightning energy. Shift the shortcut rows down only slightly if needed; use existing empty scene space, do not overcrowd. Every functional resource/control must be easy to identify. Keep all existing Cyrillic shortcut labels, the rest of the interface and original steampunk style. Do not add other UI, no device frame, no new full-screen art.

concepts.name: Панель экспедиции

Reference screenshot provides palette/painted artwork only. Create a substantially NEW, minimalist functional dashboard, not the same scattered buttons. The most restrained, legible option: matte deep petrol panels, warm amber accents only for primary action, thin consistent metal dividers, large quiet spacing. A single low-contrast painted mine lift/empty station vista sits in a wide environment card in the middle; NO separate full-body character standing on the background (player avatar remains in the top header). Top header contains square hooded explorer avatar, «ProKrust», «Уровень 24», a slim XP bar, and equal small inventory bag and gear/settings icon buttons (both visible). Directly below: one tidy strip with FOUR small resource symbols and numeric balances (ore, gold, purple matter, lightning energy). Then a 2 by 2 grid of equal compact icon+text navigation cards, labels «Магазин», «Мировой босс», «Награда за вход», «Задания дня». Use one unified sober visual language, less ornament, fewer bevels, no glowing frames. The middle environment card is atmospheric with plenty of breathing room. Preserve the recognizable bottom mine CTA card structure: mine scene thumbnail on left, «Шахта ждёт», short subtitle, large amber «В ШАХТУ» button on right. Preserve the five equal bottom navigation buttons with labels exactly «Убежище», «Достижения», «Герой», «Арена», «Мастерская»; selected Shelter with one subtle amber underline. No device frame, watermark, concept title outside screen, excessive decoration or small unreadable explanations. Professional production-ready-looking concept with exact, sharp readable Cyrillic.

concepts.name: Свет у шахты
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. One complete portrait 9:16 mobile game home screen concept C «Свет у шахты» for Russian steampunk mining RPG Escape. Reference only for existing painted dark teal/amber style and bottom mine card/nav. Make a visually distinct NEW composition, notably cleaner and more minimalist. Background: dim, quiet underground refuge room at the entrance of an elevator shaft, soft warm vertical light beam, clear stone/metal floor. One realistically scaled hooded bronze-and-black explorer stands grounded on the RIGHT of the middle scene, large enough to feel intentional, lit by the lamp with a contact shadow. The scene is calm and unbusy. TOP: neat compact horizontal profile header (avatar, «ProKrust», «Уровень 24», slim XP), equal small inventory bag and settings gear buttons on right. Separate narrow resource strip with FOUR icons and balances (ore, gold, matter, energy). LEFT SIDE of scene: THREE compact horizontal dark backing buttons in a VERTICAL column with restrained small sculpted icons on left and clear Russian labels on right: «Рейтинг», «Друзья», «Почта». One coherent thin frame/style, bright readable text, friends button equally strong. Near bottom of scene: two equal compact horizontal buttons «Магазин» and «Мировой босс». Under the resource strip, two small quiet text+icon pills «Награда за вход» and «Задания дня». No giant square tiles, no scattered buttons, no numerous luminous outlines. Preserve recognizable large lower mine card: thumbnail mine scene on left, «Шахта ждёт», subtitle, amber «В ШАХТУ» button. Preserve five equal bottom tabs with exact labels «Убежище», «Достижения», «Герой», «Арена», «Мастерская», one understated amber selected underline. Restrained premium painted steampunk, much more negative space, strong hierarchy, consistent navigation, all text sharp Cyrillic. No watermark/device frame/multi-panel comparison/title outside interface.
